description: Unset optional fields are empty rather than a type fallback; declared defaults apply; unknown keys are dropped with a warning; type violations fail; rich text is stored as authored.

cases.name: Defaults and an empty values document are empty except declared defaults and min_items rows
Unknown keys at every level are dropped and reported
A type violation still fails even when unknown keys are present

A required Select without a value fails
